summary: Arxis, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a merger agreement to acquire Omnetics Connector Corporation via forward triangular merger. Arxis will issue shares of its Class A common stock as consideration, valued at approximately $770 million. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock acquisition with a possible cash true-up and an $8 million escrow. Omnetics shareholders will sign support agreements with restrictive covenants. Closing is subject to regulatory approval. What to watch: regulatory clearance timeline and NASDAQ trading volume/price alignment for share consideration; risk-arb focuses on stock-for-stock valuation discipline.
